families.label: Health Plan and Care Delivery Operations
families.definition: Administration of health plans, provider networks, pharmacy benefits, hospitals, outpatient facilities, and senior living care-delivery organizations.

capabilities.label: Health plan administration
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to design, enroll, price, administer, service, and govern health benefit plans and their member, claim, and payment operations.

capabilities.label: Managed care network administration
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to establish, contract, credential, coordinate, measure, and administer provider networks and managed care delivery arrangements.

capabilities.label: Pharmacy benefit management
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to administer prescription benefit formularies, pharmacy networks, claims, pricing, utilization controls, and related member services.

capabilities.label: Hospital operations
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to own, manage, or operate inpatient healthcare facilities with integrated clinical, diagnostic, pharmacy, facility, revenue, and safety systems.

capabilities.label: Outpatient care facility operations
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to own, manage, or operate ambulatory, physician, urgent, diagnostic, surgical, or other outpatient care facilities and services.

capabilities.label: Senior living facility operations
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to own, manage, or operate independent living, assisted living, memory care, or continuing-care facilities and resident services.
